items.title: Tony Parenti and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-06-29

ctx.x: Well we've got a good cause there fellow The cause is uh a traditional part of our New Orleans And uh I think uh You gotta get a lot of credit to a lot of the boys down there to pull a good cause like that Of course there Sharky's still talking around doing a good job All those boys down there That's right And you know something about Sharky He still plays good Exceptionally good He's about the nicest little section land front of the flare Uh That That That is authentically right But uh I know that Seashions…
No No When a fellow took over Pete Millen Harry's Vice President Now But I think Pete may retire He's been sick So Harry might take over again

Well they're doing a good cause down there Don't they? They all deserve a tremendous lot of credit Because uh the warrant for that group of boys I wouldn't know what would happen to upholding the good cause And I certainly give them a great amount of appreciation And I certainly hope that uh It will come to a point where it will come to be It will be accepted to the degree where a shrine or something will be built up for That'll be internationally known Where they should have a Go down in the Orleans just to go…
